profile.summary: My Other Brother (MOB) is a nonprofit in Oakland, California that gives support services to Black American youth from low-income communities in the Bay Area. Its programs include a scholarship academy, college and career exposure, mentorship and leadership development. It also runs a sister program, My Other Sister.
